actions.blocked: An earlier action on this add-on is not confirmed yet. Check its status or dismiss it first.
actions.failed: The owner did not complete the action. Nothing was changed. Try again to start a new attempt.
actions.notApplied: The owner reported the action as done, but the add-on did not change. Try again to start a new attempt.
actions.unknown: The owner did not confirm the action yet. It may still be applied. Check its status, or dismiss it before you start another action.

approval.title: Approval needed
approval.rejected: The request could not be completed. Check its state and try again.
approval.expired: This request has expired. Ask for it again.

apps.emptyBody: When an administrator installs and enables an add-on, it appears here.
apps.headless: Runs in the background and has no page of its own.
apps.stale: The list could not be refreshed. What you see may be out of date.
apps.working: Waiting for the owner to confirm.

browse.confirmBody: Version {{version}} from the library {{library}} will be downloaded and verified before it is installed.
browse.confirmNotEnabled: Installing does not start the add-on. You enable it as a separate step.
browse.emptyBody: Add a library on the Libraries tab, then refresh it.
browse.installedNotEnabled: Installed. It is not enabled: enable it on the Installed tab when you are ready.

catalog.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches the search. Change the words or the library.

drawer.limitBody: The sidebar shows at most eight pinned add-ons. Unpin one first.

errors.auth: You are signed out. Sign in again.
errors.denied: The server refused this. You may not have permission, or the add-on changed. The list was refreshed.
errors.invalid: The server could not accept this request.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
errors.unavailable: The add-on owner is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.unknownOutcome: The result could not be confirmed. Check the status before you try again.

installed.emptyBody: Install an add-on from the Browse tab.
installed.uninstallBody: The add-on stops and its package is removed from use. Its data, identity and grants are kept, so installing it again picks them up. Nothing is deleted.

libraries.emptyBody: Add a library to browse and install add-ons.

errors.id: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
errors.name: Enter a name of up to 256 characters.
errors.reference: This does not look like a reference name. Use the name of a configured credential, not the secret.
errors.required: Required when a signature is required.
errors.url: Enter an http or https address.
errors.urlCredentials: The address must not contain a user name or password.
errors.urlQuery: The address must not contain a query string or fragment.

hints.id: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot change later.
hints.reference: The name of a credential the owner configured. Never paste a token or password here.
hints.url: An https address without credentials or a query string.

libraries.lead: A library is a catalog document that lists add-ons. Credentials are never typed here: a private library names a credential the owner configured.
libraries.removeBody: The library is removed from this list. Add-ons that were installed from it stay installed and keep running.

manage.failedNote_one: The process is not serving after {{count}} restart attempt.
manage.failedNote_other: The process is not serving after {{count}} restart attempts.
manage.logsNone: The output of add-on processes is not collected in this release. Health and restart attempts above are what the owner can report.

page.body: This build cannot open add-on pages yet. The add-on keeps running.
page.title: This page is not available yet

reasons.disabled: The add-on was stopped. Start it again from the Add-ons page.
reasons.removed: The add-on is not installed, or you can no longer use it.
reasons.failed: The add-on stopped responding. It is restarted automatically; reload to try again.
reasons.updated: The add-on was updated. Reload to use the new version.
reasons.no-ui: This version of the add-on has no pages.
reasons.incompatible_sdk: This add-on needs another version of the LocalAI interface than this page provides.
reasons.untrusted_asset: The add-on pointed at a file outside its own package, so it was not loaded.
reasons.invalid_module: The add-on does not follow the interface contract, so it was not loaded.
reasons.import_failed: The add-on could not be loaded.
reasons.create_failed: The add-on failed while it started.
reasons.timeout: The add-on took too long to load.
reasons.css_failed: The style sheet of the add-on could not be loaded.

shell.stale: {{title}} changed while you were editing. Your edits are still on screen but cannot be saved. Copy what you need, then reload.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.body: Reloading replaces this page, and the edits you have not saved are lost.

leave.title: Leave this page?
leave.body: You have edits that are not saved. They are lost if you leave.

noComponent.title: Nothing to show here
noComponent.body: This add-on adds actions to other pages and has no page of its own.

error.title: This add-on had a problem
error.text: It failed while drawing this page. The rest of LocalAI is not affected.

supporting: Apps your owner runs for you, and the libraries they come from.
title: Add-ons

proposal.title: Add-on change
proposal.withdrawn: This request is no longer available to you.
proposal.blocked: Another change on this database is not settled yet. Settle it first.
proposal.expired: This request has expired. Ask for it again.
proposal.rejectedState: The data changed or the request was refused. Nothing was applied. Ask again for a new preview.
proposal.unknown: The outcome is not known yet. It may have been applied. Check its status before you ask again.

artifact.title: File ready
artifact.withdrawn: This file is no longer available to you.
artifact.name: File
artifact.failed: The file could not be completed. Nothing can be downloaded. Export again.
artifact.expired: This file has expired and was removed. The data it came from is unchanged. Export again.
artifact.downloadDenied: This file can no longer be downloaded. Your access to its source changed or the file expired.
artifact.downloadFailed: The download did not finish. Try again.

recovery.title: Data recovery
recovery.retention: Keeps the newest {{count}} backups. The newest verified backup and the recovery copy of an upgrade are never removed.
recovery.none: There is no backup of this add-on's data yet.
recovery.verified: Backup {{id}} was read completely and passed.
recovery.pinnedWhy: This is the recovery copy of the last upgrade and is kept until a newer verified backup exists.
recovery.purgeLead: Purging removes retained data of this add-on for good. It is not the deletion of a database and not an uninstall.
recovery.purgeBody: This removes what you select below and cannot be undone. The add-on must be uninstalled or disabled.
recovery.scopeData: The data and every share of this add-on
recovery.scopeCopies: Data copies that restores set aside ({{count}})
recovery.warnLost: Changes made after the backup are lost. The add-on's data is replaced.
recovery.warnAccess: Shares are checked again: nobody gets back access that was taken away since the backup, or whose account is gone.
recovery.warnProposals: Proposals that were waiting are cancelled. Operations with an unknown outcome are looked up and never applied again.
recovery.warnCopy: The data that is replaced is kept as a recovery copy until you purge it.
recovery.stopFirst: Stop the add-on first: disable it, then restore.
recovery.mapping: This backup was made in local-owner mode. Account ID that takes its data
recovery.typeToConfirmLabel: Type the add-on ID to confirm

needs-recovery.title: This add-on's data needs recovery
needs-recovery.body: The add-on is not started. The previous package is kept, but it cannot read the data a failed migration began to change.
needs-recovery.hint: Restore the verified recovery copy below, or purge the data.
needs-recovery.hintNone: No verified backup is available. Purge the data to start again.

upgrading.title: An upgrade is in progress
upgrading.body: The add-on is stopped while its data is backed up and migrated.

restoring.title: A restore is in progress
restoring.body: The add-on stays stopped until the restore is finished.

purging.title: A purge is in progress
purging.body: The retained data is being removed.

errors.needs_recovery: The data needs recovery first: restore a verified backup or purge it.
errors.busy: Another recovery operation is running for this add-on.
errors.backup_not_found: That backup does not exist any more.
errors.backup_corrupt: The backup failed verification and was not used.
errors.incompatible_format: The data format does not fit the installed package.
errors.identity_changed: The installed package comes from another trusted source than the data.
errors.mapping_required: Name the account that takes the data of this backup.
errors.downgrade_unsupported: Data of named users cannot be restored in local-owner mode.
errors.sole_recovery_copy: This is the only verified recovery copy and is kept.
errors.confirmation_mismatch: The typed ID does not match.
errors.operation_conflict: This operation ID was used for another request. Nothing was done.
errors.invalid_request: The request cannot be carried out as given.
errors.insufficient_storage: There is not enough free storage for a backup. Nothing was changed.
errors.unknownOutcome: The outcome is not known. Read the state again: the same action is not sent twice.
errors.denied: Only administrators can do this, from their own browser session.
errors.network: The owner could not be reached.

state.check-failed: The update check failed, so it is not known whether an update exists.
state.integrity-error: The library lists the installed version with different contents. Nothing was changed and no update is offered.

confirm.title: Upgrade {{name}} to {{version}}?
confirm.body: The add-on stops while its data is backed up and migrated, then the new version starts. If the new version does not start, the current version keeps running.
confirm.data: Its data is backed up before anything changes.

updates.progress: Upgrading {{name}}. Its data is backed up first.
updates.browseUpdate: Update {{version}} is available. Manage it in Installed.

errors.candidate_changed: The library no longer offers the version you checked. Check for updates again.
errors.upgrade_conflict: This upgrade is already recorded under another operation. It was not applied twice.
errors.incompatible: The new version is not compatible with this host. Nothing was changed.
errors.integrity_error: The library lists the installed version with different contents. Nothing was changed.
errors.upgrade_failed: The upgrade did not complete and the installed version is kept. You can try again.
errors.operation_conflict: The operation does not fit the current state. Nothing was applied.
errors.check_failed: The library could not be read, so the upgrade was not started. Nothing was changed.
errors.unknownOutcome: The result of the upgrade is not known. Read its status again; do not start another.
